entities.summary: Great Rebellion, a transformative movement in Peru (1742–1783). Emerged from Juan Santos Atahualpa's rebellion in the jungle — 1742 and Spanish Empire. Catalyzed Túpac Amaru II executed in Cusco — May 18, 1781 and San Martín declares Peruvian independence — July 28, 1821.
